_comment: Expectations per site for `page_load.py check`. status is the last run of docs/browser-sites.md (ok, warn, fail; excluded: not judged). max_errors: [error] console entries of an agent navigate on the replay. md: strings `dump --md --js` must contain. task_fails (optional): the failure `check --agent` prints today for the site's task in agent_tasks/; another failure fails the site. visual (every site not excluded): the last screens review, {"status": "ok" or "defects", "date", "defects": [short descriptions, a backlog id first when one matches]} ("defects" only with status defects); a review compares `check --screens` (target/screens/) with the live page in Chrome; `check` prints it and counts W3 (content pass and visual ok). Values hold on the archives captured 2026-10-07; tighten them as sites are fixed.
